notes: The floor sends toolArgs as a JSON string; from 1.0.83, measured 2026-09-14 against 1.0.83 itself, every tool but apply_patch sends it as an object. Reading only the string form cost the hook every argument on that build - no command, no path, nothing to place against a run - so both forms are read and this fixture is the object half. The bash-pending fixture beside it is the string half, and the two must decide alike.
